pub17.note: IRS's own plain-language publication; typically already states current-year adjusted figures.

section_63.note: Defines standard deduction structure; base dollar amounts in the statute are adjusted annually for inflation via separate IRS revenue procedures. Do not treat dollar figures here as current-year amounts.

section_61.note: Defines gross income; not a dollar-figure section.

section_152.note: Defines dependents; contains some thresholds that may still be indexed elsewhere, but not the primary annually-adjusted figures.

current_figures_reference.note: Internally maintained current-year figures reference, sourced from the annual IRS revenue procedure.
